rule: Write commit messages in imperative mood: 'Add feature' not 'Added feature' or 'Adding feature'
Keep commit subject lines under 72 characters; use the body for context on why, not what
Each commit must leave tests passing; never commit with a known failing test as a checkpoint
Use conventional commit prefixes: feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore — not generic 'update'
Do not amend published commits; create a new fixup commit instead
